concept:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: premium photorealistic spaceship concept design sheet for the space-mining game BELT RUNNER 3D.
Primary request: invent a beautiful new civilian cargo carrier with a much LESS BLOCKY silhouette. Creative freedom. A substantial working freighter that feels engineered, inhabited, and dependable. Its entire form should flow from broad rounded shoulders through a long tapered hull, like a sculpted ocean-going research vessel translated into spacecraft. Length approximately 4.3 times beam. Smooth compound-curved armor shells, elliptical hull cross-sections, gently chamfered service recesses, an integrated low bridge, a tapered sculpted bow, and a strong continuous structural keel. Several large curved hull sections separated by narrow purposeful service gaps. Cargo volume is enclosed within the body. Use curved major shapes with crisp precision panel seams, not a stack of box modules or rectangular containers. It must still read as a large cargo ship rather than a fighter, yacht or passenger cruise liner. No broad aircraft wings.

Functional details: a recessed SIDE through-hangar amidships with rounded-rectangle mouth and visible warm interior; a small mining shuttle at the opening establishes the enormous size of the ship. A compact articulated circular mining/communications dish on a faired dorsal mount, low enough to preserve the silhouette. Exactly three main engine bells clustered into one beautifully integrated stern housing, with restrained pale cyan-blue plasma light. Recessed cargo handling machinery, docking collars, access hatches and quiet navigation lights. Thick curved hull edges around the hangar rather than thin cosmetic fins. Plausible service access and reinforcement. Very small warm amber bridge and crew windows.

Materials: warm pale titanium / ivory painted alloy on the flowing upper shell, dark graphite lower keel and recessed mechanical sections, small muted ochre industrial markings. Fine realistic roughness and brushed-metal grain, slight wear concentrated at service edges, restrained heat tint on engine metal. Moderately used, carefully maintained civilian equipment. Strong surface hierarchy: clean large shapes first, meaningful engineering detail second. No random greeble clutter.

Composition: one polished LANDSCAPE design board. Upper approximately 72 percent is a very large HERO front-port three-quarter view, bow pointing right, enough elevation to show the broad sculpted dorsal shape and side hangar. Entire ship fits inside the frame with comfortable margins; no cropped bow or stern. Deep charcoal blue-black space backdrop with a subtle distant planetary rim, very sparse stars. Lower strip has TWO supporting images separated by thin subtle rules: rear three-quarter view clearly revealing all three engines, and a close view of the rounded hangar mouth with shuttle inside. All three views MUST depict the exact SAME ship design and paint layout, not different ships. Hero occupies most of the board and looks cinematic rather than a technical line drawing.

Lighting: realistic hard sunlight from upper left, soft blue planetary bounce, rich physically plausible specular reflections describing curved hull surfaces, detailed dark areas still readable, naturally warm interior light, extremely restrained bloom. High quality path-traced VFX miniature photography aesthetic. No cartoon shading, no fisheye.

Text: only a tasteful small top-left heading "BELT RUNNER 3D" with a smaller subtitle "CARGO CARRIER / NEW HULL CONCEPT". No other labels, no dimension tables, no dense annotations, no watermark.

textures.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: square seamless BASE COLOR material scan for a realistically weathered rounded civilian cargo spacecraft hull. Warm pale ivory painted titanium panels with fine narrow graphite seams, long gently offset rectangular service plates, a few small recessed latches and very small flush fasteners. Clean broad areas with subtle brushed-grain detail, restrained localized dark edge wear, fine scratches and faint maintenance staining. Soft warm white / light beige metal, not blue-gray. Neutral shadowless diffuse albedo scan, strict orthographic front-on projection, no specular highlights or directional cast shadows, no perspective, no vignette. Seamless in both directions. No spacecraft silhouette, no text, no numbers, no logos, no symbols, no windows, no diagram. Crisp professional 3D game texture, continuous full-frame surface.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: square seamless BASE COLOR material scan for dark graphite industrial spacecraft hangar surfaces and exposed machinery. Dense orderly modular dark slate-gray metal panels, recessed channels and vents, brushed titanium inset plates, small screws, narrow seam joints, fine worn edges and soft localized grime. Mostly deep gray metal, readable medium gray panel detail. No lights, no glowing strips, no hazard tape, no signs, no letters or text, no perspective, no objects, no full scene. Pure orthographic shadowless diffuse texture scan, seamless repeating on all edges, restrained realistic wear, no painted highlights, no directional lighting. Fine detailed hard-surface material suitable for a maintained working cargo vessel.
